proposal.hypothesis: The split-range parent was correct but its measured mean was nearly the baseline, while the isolated rsqrtf variant was also correct and had a shorter recorded search mean. Applying the rsqrtf-based inverse-cube factor to both split loops tests whether that arithmetic change remains useful when self interactions are skipped by source ranges. The combined candidate is unmeasured; no speedup or correctness is assumed.

retained: Retain the split ascending source ranges [0, i) and (i, n), so j=i is excluded without evaluating its interaction.
In both source loops, replace sqrtf(distSq) and division by distSq * dist with an rsqrtf-based inverse-cube factor; retain target-mass multiplication and the final force-per-target-mass update.
Preserve one target per thread, the current launch configuration, and all other integration and output behavior.
